item.title: Scale drives record 2025 for Wyndham in Asia Pacific
item.description: Wyndham Hotels and Resorts has capped a breakthrough year with double-digit net room growth, plus hundreds of openings and signings across Asia Pacific. The post Scale drives record 2025 for Wyndham in Asia Pacific appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Journey Beyond completes Voyages takeover dropping ‘Indigenous’ from name
item.description: Journey Beyond has completed its acquisition of Voyages, including its iconic businesses Ayers Rock Resort in Yulara and Mossman Gorge Cultural Centre in Far North Queensland. The post Journey Beyond completes Voyages takeover dropping ‘Indigenous’ from name appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Choice lauds Gold Awards winners
item.description: Choice Hotels International Asia-Pac has revealed the 31 properties with exceptional performance in 2025 to achieve Gold Award status. The post Choice lauds Gold Awards winners appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Marriott to bring luxurious St. Regis to New Zealand
item.description: Marriott International has signed an agreement with PHC Queenstown Limited to debut a new-build 145-key St. Regis Hotels & Resorts in Queenstown, slated to open in late 2027. The post Marriott to bring luxurious St. Regis to New Zealand appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: AHICE Asia Pacific stage set for strong return to Adelaide in May with 250 speakers and 1600 delegates expected
item.description: After a stellar 2025 edition, the 17th annual Asia Pacific Hotel Industry Conference and Exhibition (AHICE) returns to Adelaide Oval from 5 to 7 May 2026, securing its reputation as the largest and most influential accommodation event in the region. The post AHICE Asia Pacific stage set for strong return to Adelaide in May with 250 speakers and 1600 delegates expected appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: inside the Regent Taipei, one of Taiwan’s finest hotels
item.description: For decades, the Regent Taipei has been one of the leading luxury hotels in Taiwan. To find out what makes the property so unique, James Wilkinson caught up with the Regent Taipei General Manager, Simon Wu. The post Exclusive: inside the Regent Taipei, one of Taiwan’s finest hotels appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: Era of Ardouration
item.description: 2026 is set to be a mega year for Salter Brothers Hospitality as the Ardour brand makes a splash and major projects come to fruition, CEO Tash Tobias tells Ruth Hogan. The post Exclusive: Era of Ardouration appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Hospitality industry marks International Women’s Day
item.description: Ahead of Sunday’s annual International Women’s Day, HM shines a spotlight on some of the women and new initiatives across the hotel industry in support of female talent. The post Hospitality industry marks International Women’s Day appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Six Senses London debut breathes ‘new life into a once-sleeping giant’ at The Whiteley
item.description: Six Senses has arrived in the UK with its first urban property in London, occupying a full quarter of The Whiteley mixed-use development, historically the city's first department store.
